label: Bible Study
prompt: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the _____ of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
verse: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
note: Heaven announces the wedding of the Lamb — and the bride has made herself ready.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He _____ my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verse: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
note: He restoreth my soul — the Shepherd doesn't just lead, He repairs.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick _____ in all the land of Egypt three days:
verse: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
note: Three days of darkness so thick it could be felt — yet all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the _____ of the LORD it shall be seen.
verse: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
note: After the ram in the thicket, Abraham names the place 'The LORD will provide' — and it became a proverb.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as _____ between thine eyes.
verse: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
note: Bind God's words on your hand and as 'frontlets between thine eyes' — the root of the phylacteries mentioned in Matthew 23:5.
